The Navajo Nation has lands in Utah, Arizona and New Mexico today.


Source 3N: https://www.navajo-nsn.gov/History

## Source 3C: Cherokee Nation
Cherokee Nation is the government of the Cherokee people today.
It is based in Tahlequah, Oklahoma.


Source 3C: https://www.cherokee.gov/about-the-nation/

Original paraphrase; no source wording or images copied.

## Source 3I: Inuit Tapiriit Kanatami
Inuit are an Indigenous people living primarily in Inuit Nunangat.
Nunavut is one of its regions. Nunavut is also a Canadian territory.


Source 3I: https://itk.ca/about-canadian-inuit/

Original paraphrase; no source wording or images copied.
